children.value: > Fact From Story Google and parent company Alphabet are accused of anticompetitive behavior in violation of U.S. antitrust law, the Sherman Act, and others, on behalf of news publishers.
> > Fact From Story The case argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Siphoning off content, readers, and ad revenue is a type of anticompetitive behavior.
> Commonsense Knowledge Antitrust law prohibits anticompetitive behavior.
